title: Grateful Dead Live at Mill Valley Recreation Center on 1980-12-06
lineage: Betty's Master Cassette (Dennon DN-770R) > Sony R500  Sony R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 > FLAC (16-bit/44.1k)
source: AKG C414 Stereo Pair > Sony D5 - Betty Cantor-Jackson's Master Cassette (UD-XL II 60)

ai_review.summary: Mellow, well‑recorded performance with a great vibe and solid sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the recording’s clear, mellow sound and the relaxed atmosphere of the show. Garcia’s intro for Phil, Brent and Mickey is highlighted positively, and the overall feel is described as good‑vibe and enjoyable. No specific song issues are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments on both performance vibe and sound quality, but only two brief reviews limit certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note great/good sound that is super mellow and clear; no specific technical problems mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Relaxed, mellow flow with a pleasant vibe throughout the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia steps up for Phil, Brent, Mickey and is noted positively.
